tools.name: ExitPlanMode
tools.description:
Use this tool when you are in plan mode and have finished writing your plan to the plan file and are ready for user approval.

## How This Tool Works
- You should have already written your plan to the plan file specified in the plan mode system message
- This tool does NOT take the plan content as a parameter - it will read the plan from the file you wrote
- This tool simply signals that you're done planning and ready for the user to review and approve
- The user will see the contents of your plan file when they review it

## When to Use This Tool
IMPORTANT: Only use this tool when the task requires planning the implementation steps of a task that requires writing code. For research tasks where you're gathering information, searching files, reading files or in general trying to understand the codebase - do NOT use this tool.

## Before Using This Tool
Ensure your plan is complete and unambiguous:
- If you have unresolved questions about requirements or approach, use AskUserQuestion first (in earlier phases)
- Once your plan is finalized, use THIS tool to request approval

**Important:** Do NOT use AskUserQuestion to ask "Is this plan okay?" or "Should I proceed?" - that's exactly what THIS tool does. ExitPlanMode inherently requests user approval of your plan.

## Examples

1. Initial task: "Search for and understand the implementation of vim mode in the codebase" - Do not use the exit plan mode tool because you are not planning the implementation steps of a task.
2. Initial task: "Help me implement yank mode for vim" - Use the exit plan mode tool after you have finished planning the implementation steps of the task.
3. Initial task: "Add a new feature to handle user authentication" - If unsure about auth method (OAuth, JWT, etc.), use AskUserQuestion first, then use exit plan mode tool after clarifying the approach.

tools.name: ExitWorktree
tools.description:
Exit a worktree session created by EnterWorktree and return the session to the original working directory.

## Scope

This tool ONLY operates on worktrees created by EnterWorktree in this session. It will NOT touch:
- Worktrees you created manually with `git worktree add`
- Worktrees from a previous session (even if created by EnterWorktree then)
- The directory you're in if EnterWorktree was never called

If called outside an EnterWorktree session, the tool is a **no-op**: it reports that no worktree session is active and takes no action. Filesystem state is unchanged.

## When to Use

- The user explicitly asks to "exit the worktree", "leave the worktree", "go back", or otherwise end the worktree session
- Do NOT call this proactively — only when the user asks

## Parameters

- `action` (required): `"keep"` or `"remove"`
  - `"keep"` — leave the worktree directory and branch intact on disk. Use this if the user wants to come back to the work later, or if there are changes to preserve.
  - `"remove"` — delete the worktree directory and its branch. Use this for a clean exit when the work is done or abandoned.
- `discard_changes` (optional, default false): only meaningful with `action: "remove"`. If the worktree has uncommitted files or commits not on the original branch, the tool will REFUSE to remove it unless this is set to `true`. If the tool returns an error listing changes, confirm with the user before re-invoking with `discard_changes: true`.

## Behavior

- Restores the session's working directory to where it was before EnterWorktree
- Clears CWD-dependent caches (system prompt sections, memory files, plans directory) so the session state reflects the original directory
- If a tmux session was attached to the worktree: killed on `remove`, left running on `keep` (its name is returned so the user can reattach)
- Once exited, EnterWorktree can be called again to create a fresh worktree

tools.description:
Replaces, inserts, or deletes a single cell in a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb file).

Usage:
- You must use the Read tool on the notebook in this conversation before editing — this tool will fail otherwise.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: SendMessage
tools.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

1	# Qt 看板代码骨架与完整调用链
2	
3	> 日期：2026-11-05（2026-11-06 续：孤儿清理 + 真实消费者接入；2026-11-06 五续：补 UI 测试与三个真 bug）
4	> 分类：探索 / 工作流外实施
5	> 结果：**ARM64 已构建并上板跑通**，真实 D-Bus 取数 3/3 成功，离屏渲染做像素级验证；
6	> VNC 平台插件跑通完整图形栈并做 15 分钟长稳（零泄漏、零错误）；
7	> 已删除全部孤儿接口并给已解析字段接入真实消费者（数据层 39/39 通过）；
8	> **代码层面已无孤儿，可交付性只剩 2 项**（HDMI 实机验收、`auto_scale` 产品决策）
9	
10	## 构思
11	
12	### 要解决什么问题
13	
14	开发板接 HDMI 显示器时，能在板端本地查看 WeakNet 的诊断状态，不依赖
15	远程 SSH 或云端。这是根目录 `内核模块技术栈引入讨论.md` 方向一（路径 A1）。
16	
17	### 为什么不走 OpenSpec change
18	
19	1. 这是**探索性代码骨架**，不是已批准的产品表面。按 CLAUDE.md 铁律，
20	   没有 approved requirement、真实消费者和可观测命令的接口属于 orphan，
21	   不该走正式变更流程。
22	2. 用户明确指示「不用新开工作流。直接开始实现基本的代码结构」，
23	   后续又明确「把第一第二部做了，然后第三步等显示器；不用新开工作流」。
24	3. 代码放在独立目录 `qt_dashboard/`，不接入根构建，不修改任何现有文件，
25	   对主项目零影响。
26	
27	### 备选方案与取舍
28	
29	| 方案 | 取舍 |
30	|------|------|
31	| 复用 `client/weaknet_client.h` C API | **选它**。29KB 封装已就绪，50+ 只读函数，返回 JSON |
32	| 自己实现 D-Bus 客户端 | 弃。`weaknet_cli` 之外再写一套是重复 |
33	| 引入 nlohmann/json | 弃。全仓不用第三方 JSON，`net_info.cpp:15` 记录了该决定 |
34	| 引入 Qt Charts | 弃。板端无 `libqt5charts5`；且无法脱离显示器测试 |
35	| QPainter 自绘 + 渲染到 QImage | **选它**。可像素级单测，无显示器也能验证 |
36	| 接入根 CMakeLists.txt | 弃。看板是可选界面，不该拖累主部署产物构建 |
37	| 同步 D-Bus 调用放 UI 线程 | 弃。服务端忙时会冻结界面，必须有后台线程 |
38	
39	## 实现方式
40	
41	### 新增文件（全部在独立目录，未改动任何既有文件）
42	
43	```
44	qt_dashboard/                          19 个文件，代码 4423 行（含 2 个构建脚本）
45	├── README.md                  设计决定与验证状态
46	├── CMakeLists.txt             164 行，独立 project，四 target
47	├── main.cpp                   181 行，入口，QCommandLineParser
48	├── data/                      ← 不依赖 Qt
49	│   ├── json_reader.hpp/cpp    160 / 450 行，路径式查找 + 根数组支持
50	│   ├── dashboard_data.hpp/cpp 281 / 223 行，POD + 解析
51	│   └── data_source.hpp/cpp    134 / 163 行，调 libweaknet + 缓冲扩容
52	├── ui/                        ← 依赖 Qt
53	│   ├── line_chart_widget.hpp/cpp  98 / 217 行，QPainter 折线图
54	│   ├── data_fetch_thread.hpp/cpp  115 / 157 行，QThread 后台取数 + init 重试
55	│   └── main_window.hpp/cpp        160 / 539 行，主窗口
56	├── tools/
57	│   ├── build-arm64.sh                ARM64 交叉编译（x86 moc + arm64 clang）
58	│   └── fetch-qt-arm64-sysroot.sh     往 sysroot 装 arm64 Qt 头/库
59	└── tests/
60	    ├── test_json_reader.cpp         39 个用例（数据层，含 6 个真机样本）
61	    ├── test_line_chart_widget.cpp    8 个用例（UI 像素级，QImage 断言）
62	    └── fixtures/
63	        └── board_experience_real.json   板端实测快照（带来源标注）
64	```
65	
66	### 调用链
67	
68	```
69	main.cpp   QApplication + 命令行
70	  └── MainWindow                 顶栏 / 维度列表 / 趋势图 / 诊断栏
71	        ├── DataFetchThread      QThread，后台取数（禁止在 UI 线程调 D-Bus）
72	        │     └── DataSource     唯一直接调用 libweaknet 的地方
73	        │           └── weaknet_get_*()  ← client/weaknet_client.h
74	        ├── LineChartWidget      QPainter 自绘折线图
75	        └── parse_xxx()          JSON → POD（纯函数，可单测）
76	```
77	
78	### 关键决策
79	
80	**1. JSON 样本逐字取自服务端代码**
81	
82	测试里的每一段 JSON 都来自真实序列化代码，不是臆造：
83	
84	| 样本 | 来源 |
85	|------|------|
86	| 完整快照 | `server/include/assurance/legacy_adapter.hpp:162-227` |
87	| 无快照 | `server/src/dbus_service.cpp:916-917` |
88	| 快照过期 | `server/src/dbus_service.cpp:919-921` |
89	| 历史数组 | `server/src/database_manager.cpp:703-740` |
90	| 历史不可用 | `server/src/dbus_service.cpp:1530` |
91	| 诊断事实 | `server/include/assurance/diagnosis_engine.hpp:44-85` |
92	
93	这样服务端改字段名时测试会红，而不是等接上显示器才发现界面空白。
94	
95	**2. 核对真实 JSON 形状时纠正了四处臆断**
96	
97	| 字段 | 猜测 | 实际出处 |
98	|------|------|---------|
99	| 历史时间戳 | `timestamp_ms`（数字） | `ts` 是**字符串**（`database_manager.cpp:704`） |
100	| 历史分数 | `display_score` | `score` / `overall_score`（`:720-721`） |
101	| 诊断置信度 | `double [0,1]` | **字符串枚举** `HIGH`/`MEDIUM`/`LOW`（`diagnosis_engine.hpp:49`） |
102	| `excluded_causes` | `vector<string>` | `vector<{cause,reason}>`（`:65-66`） |
103	
104	**3. 枚举值也猜错了**
105	
106	`server/include/assurance/health_state.hpp:15-38` 的真实取值：
107	
108	```cpp
109	enum class HealthState { GOOD, DEGRADED, BAD, UNKNOWN };
110	// coverage: FULL_FOR_PROFILE / PARTIAL / NONE
111	```
112	
113	原设计写的是 `HEALTHY` / `FAILED` 和 `FULL`，**全错**。已修正到
114	header、`.cpp` 和测试断言（含注释）。
115	
116	**4. schema v2 的降级形状需要单独处理**
117	
118	服务端在无快照 / 快照过期时返回**顶层** `state`/`coverage`/`reason`，
119	没有 `overall` 对象。`parse_experience()` 先检测 `overall.state` 是否存在，
120	不存在就按降级形状解析，并置 `unavailable_reason`。看板据此显示
121	「等待评估」而不是 0 分。
122	
123	**5. 服务端按 `ts DESC` 返回，解析时翻转为正序**
124	
125	`queryHistory()` 的 SQL 是 `ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT ?`，最新在前。
126	`parse_history()` 在末尾 `std::reverse`，让图表从左到右是时间正序。
127	
128	**6. 缓冲区自动扩容，绝不把截断当成功**
129	
130	C API 不报告截断。取数层先给 8 KB，用 `JsonReader::valid()` 判断完整性，
131	不合法就翻倍重试，上限 4 MB。截断的 JSON 一律视为失败。
132	
133	**7. `JsonReader` 增加根数组支持**
134	
135	原设计只从 `{` 开始查找，但 `GetHistory` 返回顶层数组。补了
136	`rootIsArray()` / `getRootObjectArray()` / `rootArraySize()` 三个方法。
137	
138	### 验证手段（无 Qt 开发包的环境）
139	
140	板端 `apt install qtbase5-dev` 会级联移除 200+ KDE 包，已排除：
141	
142	```text
143	$ ssh board 'apt-get -s install qtbase5-dev > /tmp/qt-dryrun.txt'
144	$ grep -c '^Remv' /tmp/qt-dryrun.txt   →  1
145	$ grep -c '^Inst' /tmp/qt-dryrun.txt   →  23
146	
147	Remv libqt5gui5-gles [5.15.2+dfsg-4]
148	     [libkf5quickaddons5 libkdecorations2-5v5 breeze plasma-workspace
149	      kwin-x11 plasma-desktop sddm dolphin konqueror kate kmail okular
150	      ...]  ← 200+ 个 KDE 包
151	```
152	
153	`Remv` 行只有 1 条容易误读成「只删一个」，但方括号里是**全部级联受害者**。
154	且 `apt-cache search` 确认**不存在 gles 变体的 dev 包**，无绕开方案。
155	
156	**但宿主机（Ubuntu 24.04 noble）完全不同**：`apt-get -s install qtbase5-dev`

620	
621	**bug 1：初始化失败会永久卡死取数线程。**
622	
623	`weaknet_init()` 在 `client/client.cpp:1348` 的实现是：
624	
625	```cpp
626	if (g_client) return g_client->isConnected();
627	```
628	
629	而 `connected_` 只在 `initConnection()` 里赋值一次。连接失败后 `g_client`
630	仍留在全局，于是后续每次 `weaknet_init()` 都走「已初始化」分支、
631	**永远返回 false**——板端开机早期 D-Bus 尚未就绪时，看板再也连不上，
632	而原 `DataFetchThread::run()` 在 init 失败时直接 `return`，线程直接退出。
633	
634	修法两层：
635	
636	- `DataSource::init()` 失败路径调用 `weaknet_cleanup()` 把全局客户端置空
637	  （副作用是 `Logger::shutdown()`，下次 init 再 `InitGoogleLogging()`——
638	  已实测 glog 的 Init/Shutdown 反复循环 3 轮安全）；
639	- `DataFetchThread::run()` 改为按 2s 退避重试，睡眠切成 100ms 片以响应
640	  `quit_requested_`；首次失败时发 `fetchFailed` + `refreshFinished`
641	  （后者是必需的，主线程靠它清 `refresh_in_flight_`，否则手动刷新按钮永久失效）。
642	
643	**bug 2：状态栏「就绪」会吃掉失败提示。**
644	
645	原 `onRefreshFinished` 靠检查状态栏文字是否以「失败」开头来决定是否复位。
646	但那是**跨轮持久状态**：第一轮失败、第二轮成功时，第二轮会被误判成仍失败，
647	永远停在错误文案。改成每轮独立的 `round_had_failure_` 标志，
648	`onFetchFailed` 置位、`onRefreshFinished` 读取并清零。
649	
650	**bug 3：`DiagnosisSnapshot::primary_issue` 是孤儿字段。**
651	
652	`dashboard_data.cpp:160` 解析了，`apply_diagnosis()` 里从未读过

686	
687	初始化重试的实测只覆盖了**持续失败不退出线程**这一半：
688	`DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS` 指向不存在的 socket，观测到每 2s 重试一次、
689	每次调用 `weaknet_cleanup()`、线程存活、9 秒后界面仍能截图。

691	**没有**验证「环境恢复后自己连上」。要验证那一步需要在进程运行中途
692	把 D-Bus 环境修好，x86 上无法构造这个时序（改环境变量不影响已建连接，
693	建假总线又落回「一直成功」而非「先失败后成功」）。
694	该路径目前只有代码推理支撑：`weaknet_cleanup()` 把 `g_client` 置空并
695	`disconnect` → 下次 `weaknet_init()` 走完整重建 → `initConnection()` 重新赋值
696	`connected_`。**不得据此宣称「断线自动恢复」已实现。**

# Qt 看板代码骨架与完整调用链

> 日期：2026-11-05（2026-11-06 续：孤儿清理 + 真实消费者接入；2026-11-06 五续：补 UI 测试与三个真 bug）
> 分类：探索 / 工作流外实施
> 结果：**ARM64 已构建并上板跑通**，真实 D-Bus 取数 3/3 成功，离屏渲染做像素级验证；
> VNC 平台插件跑通完整图形栈并做 15 分钟长稳（零泄漏、零错误）；
> 已删除全部孤儿接口并给已解析字段接入真实消费者（数据层 39/39 通过）；
> **代码层面已无孤儿，可交付性只剩 2 项**（HDMI 实机验收、`auto_scale` 产品决策）

## 构思

### 要解决什么问题

开发板接 HDMI 显示器时，能在板端本地查看 WeakNet 的诊断状态，不依赖
远程 SSH 或云端。这是根目录 `内核模块技术栈引入讨论.md` 方向一（路径 A1）。

### 为什么不走 OpenSpec change

1. 这是**探索性代码骨架**，不是已批准的产品表面。按 CLAUDE.md 铁律，
   没有 approved requirement、真实消费者和可观测命令的接口属于 orphan，
   不该走正式变更流程。
2. 用户明确指示「不用新开工作流。直接开始实现基本的代码结构」，
   后续又明确「把第一第二部做了，然后第三步等显示器；不用新开工作流」。
3. 代码放在独立目录 `qt_dashboard/`，不接入根构建，不修改任何现有文件，
   对主项目零影响。

### 备选方案与取舍

| 方案 | 取舍 |
|------|------|
| 复用 `client/weaknet_client.h` C API | **选它**。29KB 封装已就绪，50+ 只读函数，返回 JSON |
| 自己实现 D-Bus 客户端 | 弃。`weaknet_cli` 之外再写一套是重复 |
| 引入 nlohmann/json | 弃。全仓不用第三方 JSON，`net_info.cpp:15` 记录了该决定 |
| 引入 Qt Charts | 弃。板端无 `libqt5charts5`；且无法脱离显示器测试 |
| QPainter 自绘 + 渲染到 QImage | **选它**。可像素级单测，无显示器也能验证 |
| 接入根 CMakeLists.txt | 弃。看板是可选界面，不该拖累主部署产物构建 |
| 同步 D-Bus 调用放 UI 线程 | 弃。服务端忙时会冻结界面，必须有后台线程 |

## 实现方式

### 新增文件（全部在独立目录，未改动任何既有文件）

```
qt_dashboard/                          19 个文件，代码 4423 行（含 2 个构建脚本）
├── README.md                  设计决定与验证状态
├── CMakeLists.txt             164 行，独立 project，四 target
├── main.cpp                   181 行，入口，QCommandLineParser
├── data/                      ← 不依赖 Qt
│   ├── json_reader.hpp/cpp    160 / 450 行，路径式查找 + 根数组支持
│   ├── dashboard_data.hpp/cpp 281 / 223 行，POD + 解析
│   └── data_source.hpp/cpp    134 / 163 行，调 libweaknet + 缓冲扩容
├── ui/                        ← 依赖 Qt
│   ├── line_chart_widget.hpp/cpp  98 / 217 行，QPainter 折线图
│   ├── data_fetch_thread.hpp/cpp  115 / 157 行，QThread 后台取数 + init 重试
│   └── main_window.hpp/cpp        160 / 539 行，主窗口
├── tools/
│   ├── build-arm64.sh                ARM64 交叉编译（x86 moc + arm64 clang）
│   └── fetch-qt-arm64-sysroot.sh     往 sysroot 装 arm64 Qt 头/库
└── tests/
    ├── test_json_reader.cpp         39 个用例（数据层，含 6 个真机样本）
    ├── test_line_chart_widget.cpp    8 个用例（UI 像素级，QImage 断言）
    └── fixtures/
        └── board_experience_real.json   板端实测快照（带来源标注）
```

### 调用链

```
main.cpp   QApplication + 命令行
  └── MainWindow                 顶栏 / 维度列表 / 趋势图 / 诊断栏
        ├── DataFetchThread      QThread，后台取数（禁止在 UI 线程调 D-Bus）
        │     └── DataSource     唯一直接调用 libweaknet 的地方
        │           └── weaknet_get_*()  ← client/weaknet_client.h
        ├── LineChartWidget      QPainter 自绘折线图
        └── parse_xxx()          JSON → POD（纯函数，可单测）
```

### 关键决策

**1. JSON 样本逐字取自服务端代码**

测试里的每一段 JSON 都来自真实序列化代码，不是臆造：

| 样本 | 来源 |
|------|------|
| 完整快照 | `server/include/assurance/legacy_adapter.hpp:162-227` |
| 无快照 | `server/src/dbus_service.cpp:916-917` |
| 快照过期 | `server/src/dbus_service.cpp:919-921` |
| 历史数组 | `server/src/database_manager.cpp:703-740` |
| 历史不可用 | `server/src/dbus_service.cpp:1530` |
| 诊断事实 | `server/include/assurance/diagnosis_engine.hpp:44-85` |

这样服务端改字段名时测试会红，而不是等接上显示器才发现界面空白。

**2. 核对真实 JSON 形状时纠正了四处臆断**

| 字段 | 猜测 | 实际出处 |
|------|------|---------|
| 历史时间戳 | `timestamp_ms`（数字） | `ts` 是**字符串**（`database_manager.cpp:704`） |
| 历史分数 | `display_score` | `score` / `overall_score`（`:720-721`） |
| 诊断置信度 | `double [0,1]` | **字符串枚举** `HIGH`/`MEDIUM`/`LOW`（`diagnosis_engine.hpp:49`） |
| `excluded_causes` | `vector<string>` | `vector<{cause,reason}>`（`:65-66`） |

**3. 枚举值也猜错了**

`server/include/assurance/health_state.hpp:15-38` 的真实取值：

```cpp
enum class HealthState { GOOD, DEGRADED, BAD, UNKNOWN };
// coverage: FULL_FOR_PROFILE / PARTIAL / NONE
```

原设计写的是 `HEALTHY` / `FAILED` 和 `FULL`，**全错**。已修正到
header、`.cpp` 和测试断言（含注释）。

**4. schema v2 的降级形状需要单独处理**

服务端在无快照 / 快照过期时返回**顶层** `state`/`coverage`/`reason`，
没有 `overall` 对象。`parse_experience()` 先检测 `overall.state` 是否存在，
不存在就按降级形状解析，并置 `unavailable_reason`。看板据此显示
「等待评估」而不是 0 分。

**5. 服务端按 `ts DESC` 返回，解析时翻转为正序**

`queryHistory()` 的 SQL 是 `ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT ?`，最新在前。
`parse_history()` 在末尾 `std::reverse`，让图表从左到右是时间正序。

**6. 缓冲区自动扩容，绝不把截断当成功**

C API 不报告截断。取数层先给 8 KB，用 `JsonReader::valid()` 判断完整性，
不合法就翻倍重试，上限 4 MB。截断的 JSON 一律视为失败。

**7. `JsonReader` 增加根数组支持**

原设计只从 `{` 开始查找，但 `GetHistory` 返回顶层数组。补了
`rootIsArray()` / `getRootObjectArray()` / `rootArraySize()` 三个方法。

### 验证手段（无 Qt 开发包的环境）

板端 `apt install qtbase5-dev` 会级联移除 200+ KDE 包，已排除：

```text
$ ssh board 'apt-get -s install qtbase5-dev > /tmp/qt-dryrun.txt'
$ grep -c '^Remv' /tmp/qt-dryrun.txt   →  1
$ grep -c '^Inst' /tmp/qt-dryrun.txt   →  23

Remv libqt5gui5-gles [5.15.2+dfsg-4]
     [libkf5quickaddons5 libkdecorations2-5v5 breeze plasma-workspace
      kwin-x11 plasma-desktop sddm dolphin konqueror kate kmail okular
      ...]  ← 200+ 个 KDE 包
```

`Remv` 行只有 1 条容易误读成「只删一个」，但方括号里是**全部级联受害者**。
且 `apt-cache search` 确认**不存在 gles 变体的 dev 包**，无绕开方案。

**但宿主机（Ubuntu 24.04 noble）完全不同**：`apt-get -s install qtbase5-dev`
的 `Remv` 行数为 **0**，108 个 `Inst` 全是新增。板端危险是因为
`libqt5gui5` 与 `libqt5gui5-gles` 互斥且 KDE 依赖 gles 变体；宿主机没装 KDE，
无此冲突。**宿主机直装是安全的**，版本 `5.15.13` 还比 bullseye 的 `5.15.2` 新。

当时因为先撞上 Docker/apt 网络超时、又没做宿主机 dry-run,才绕路用了 deb staging。
记录在此避免重复绕路。**未解决的是 ARM64**：cross sysroot 里没有 Qt dev，
arm64 包只能从 bullseye 源装，那正是会拆 KDE 的一套。

宿主机同样不装系统包，改为**下载 deb 解压到临时目录**：

```bash
# 1. 从 mirrors.aliyun.com/debian 下载 amd64 的 Qt 头文件 + 运行库 + moc
#    解压到 /tmp/qtstage/root（不安装到系统）
dpkg-deb -x qtbase5-dev_*.deb /tmp/qtstage/root
dpkg-deb -x qtbase5-dev-tools_*.deb /tmp/qtstage/root   # moc 真身在这里
dpkg-deb -x libqt5gui5_*.deb /tmp/qtstage/root
# ... libmd4c / libdouble-conversion / libicu / libpcre2-16 等间接依赖

# 2. 手动跑 moc
moc ui/line_chart_widget.hpp -o moc_line_chart_widget.cpp
moc ui/data_fetch_thread.hpp -o moc_data_fetch_thread.cpp
moc ui/main_window.hpp       -o moc_main_window.cpp

# 3. 编译 + 链接
g++ -std=c++17 -fPIC -Wall -Wextra \
    -I. -I../client -I$QTINC -I$QTINC/QtCore -I$QTINC/QtGui -I$QTINC/QtWidgets \
    -c <每个 .cpp>
g++ -o weaknet_dashboard *.o \
    -L$QTLIB -lQt5Widgets -lQt5Gui -lQt5Core \
    -L<build-x86>/client/lib -lweaknet \
    -Wl,-rpath-link,$QTLIB

# 4. 运行
QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ./weaknet_dashboard --help
```

## 结果

### 已完成

| 项 | 状态 | 证据 |
|----|------|------|
| 数据层编译 | ✅ 零警告 | `-Wall -Wextra` 通过 |
| 数据层单测 | ✅ **34/34 通过**（含 6 个真机样本用例） | `ctest` 0.03s |
| 取数层编译 | ✅ 通过 | 链接真实 `weaknet_client.h`，签名全对 |
| UI 层 **moc** | ✅ **3/3 生成成功** | `Q_OBJECT`/信号槽声明语法正确 |
| UI 层编译 | ✅ **零警告** | `main.cpp` + 3 个 ui 源文件 + 3 个 moc 产物，共 7 个单元全部通过 |
| **完整链接** | ✅ **成功** | 365712 字节可执行文件，无 undefined reference |
| **实际运行** | ✅ **启动正常** | `--help` 正确输出；`offscreen` 下持续运行 8 秒不崩溃 |
| CMake 配置 + 构建 + ctest | ✅ 全流程跑通 | `-DWEAKN_DASHBOARD_WITH_UI=OFF` 路径 |
| 服务端 JSON 形状核对 | ✅ 逐字段对照真实序列化代码 | 见上表行号 |

### 编译过程中抓到的 3 个真实 bug（全部已修）

| # | 错误 | 后果 |
|---|------|------|
| 1 | `main_window.cpp` 缺 `#include <QTimer>` | `invalid use of incomplete type 'class QTimer'` |
| 2 | `state_color(snap.overall_state)`：`std::string` → `QString` 无隐式转换 | 编译失败 |
| 3 | 同上，另一处 `state_color(item.state)` | 编译失败 |

这证明「未编译验证」不是形式主义——**代码确实有错**。

### 未完成（明确边界）

| 项 | 原因 |
|----|------|
| **HDMI 实机显示** | 唯一剩余项。显示器未在位（`HDMI disconnected`），eglfs 真机路径未跑 |
| 长时间运行稳定性 | 只跑了数分钟级，未做长稳 |

### 2026-11-05 续：ARM64 构建 + 板端真实取数与渲染（已完成）

上一轮停在「未验证 D-Bus 取数」，本轮把它全部打通。

#### 突破点：moc 用 x86，编译器用 arm64

板端装 Qt dev 会拆 KDE（200+ 包），此路已死。真正的解法是：

> **moc 是构建期工具，产物只是展开 `Q_OBJECT` 宏的普通 C++ 源码，与目标架构无关。**

因此用宿主机 x86 的 `moc 5.15.13`（`qtbase5-dev-tools`，零卸载）+ sysroot 里的
arm64 Qt 头文件/运行库 + `clang --target=aarch64-linux-gnu`，**不需要 Docker、
不需要 QEMU、不需要碰板端包管理器**。固化为 `qt_dashboard/tools/build-arm64.sh`。

产物 `build-qt-arm64/weaknet_dashboard`：399 KB，最高 glibc 需求 **2.17**
（板端 2.31），依赖 `libQt5Widgets/Gui/Core/DBus` + `libweaknet.so`，板端四个
Qt 运行库实测齐全。

#### 真实取数：5/5 全部成功

写一次性探针直接调 C API（用完即删，未入库）：

| API | 结果 | 大小 |
|-----|------|------|
| `weaknet_get_network_experience` | ✅ | 4129 B，schema v2，`DEGRADED`/`PARTIAL`/55 |
| `weaknet_get_diagnosis` | ✅ | 285 B |
| `weaknet_get_history` | ✅ | 50317 B / 60 条 |
| `weaknet_get_interfaces` | ✅ | 5 B（**裸字符串 `wlan0`，不是 JSON**） |
| `weaknet_health_check` | ✅ | 534 B |

`interfaces` 返回裸字符串是个**易踩的坑**：它不是 JSON。当前看板没有消费它，
所以未受影响；将来接入时必须按纯文本处理，不能丢给 `JsonReader`。

> **后续变化（2026-11-06 四续）**：`DataSource` 未加 `interfaces` / `health`
> 的取数方法后，`weaknet_get_interfaces` 与 `weaknet_health_check` 在看板侧
> 无任何消费者，属于孤儿，已连同 `FetchResult` 的对应字段一并删除。
> 因此「真实取数」从 5/5 收窄为 **3/3**（experience / diagnosis / history）。
> 这两个 C API 本身仍在 `client/weaknet_client.h` 里，由 `weaknet_cli` 使用，
> 不是项目级孤儿。

#### 真实渲染：像素级差分验证

给 `main.cpp` 加 `--screenshot <path> [--screenshot-delay ms]`，用 `offscreen`
平台插件跑真实 arm64 二进制，首轮取数完成后 `window.grab()` 存 PNG。

| 检查 | 真实数据（wlan0） | 对照（`--interface nosuchif0`） |
|------|------------------|------------------------------|
| `y=341` 折线连续段 | **674 px**（329..1003，与 `plot` 边界吻合） | **无折线** |
| 图表中心提示文字 | **0 px** | **396 px**（"暂无历史数据"） |
| 状态色 绿/黄/红/灰 | 75 / 96 / 14 / 428 采样点 | — |

真实 60 个点 score 全为 55.0 → 折线是水平线且居中，与 `auto_scale` 的
`(hi-lo)<1e-6 → ±5` 兜底一致。

#### 顺手修掉的两个真问题

1. **`--interface` 是孤儿参数**：`main.cpp` 解析了却从未传给 `MainWindow`，
   属于「有接口无消费者」。补上 `MainWindow::setInterface()` 后才真正生效——
   上面那张对照组截图正是它生效的证明。
2. **`HistorySeries::score_range()` 是多余的第二套轴逻辑**：只被测试引用，
   而 `LineChartWidget::paint()` 内部另算了一套带边距的轴（含 ±5 兜底）。
   两个函数对同一概念给出不同答案，后来者必用错。经用户确认后**删除**，
   连带删掉 2 个只为它存在的测试。

#### 删除后回归：截图逐像素对比

改动前后各截一张 1024x700：

- 差异 **1042 px**，全部落在两处含运行时刻的文字区域
  （右上角时间戳 `y=20..32 x=966..1013`、底栏诊断 `y=611..622 x=451..1000`）
- 图表区、左侧维度列表、分数、状态色**完全一致**

证明重构没有改变渲染行为。

#### 测试与回归

| 项 | 状态 |
|----|------|
| 数据层单测 | ✅ **34/34 通过** |
| 其中新增真机样本用例 | ✅ **6 个**（`BoardRealSampleTest`） |
| 样本留存 | `qt_dashboard/tests/fixtures/board_experience_real.json`（带来源标注） |
| ARM64 重编译 | ✅ 零警告 |
| 板端重部署 + 重截图 | ✅ 通过 |

新增的 `BoardRealSampleTest` 与原有测试**不是重复**：原有样本抄自服务端
序列化代码（验证「代码怎么写」），新样本取自运行中的服务端（验证「实际返回什么」）。
本轮就靠它抓到两处真实差异：

1. `assessment_profile` 真机是 `INTERNET_ACCESS`，代码抄本写的是 `FULL`
2. 真机同时出现 GOOD/BAD/DEGRADED/UNKNOWN 四种状态，且有 `UNKNOWN + PARTIAL`
   这种「有覆盖但不可用」的组合——这是抄本样本覆盖不到的

**写测试时踩的坑**：我给历史样本写的是 ASC 顺序，而服务端实际按 `DESC` 返回
（`parse_history` 负责翻转）。测试失败暴露的是样本错了，不是代码错了。
真实样本必须保留原始顺序，否则测不到翻转逻辑。

### 2026-11-05 再续：折线「贴顶 + 沉底」排查（结论：渲染正确，无 bug）

上一轮收尾时发现截图里折线大部分贴在绘图区顶端（y=121）、还有一处垂直
下探到 y=561，而当时查数据库看到最近记录全是 55.0，怀疑是渲染或解析错误。
本轮把它查清，**结论是折线渲染完全正确**，错的是核对方法。

#### 关键教训：拿「此刻」的数据去核对「十几分钟前」的截图

第一轮核对查的是当前时刻最近 120 条，全是 55.0，于是断定折线形状不合理。
但截图是 14:08 拍的，而数据库查询已经跑到 14:20 之后，时间窗口早已移过去了。

按截图时间回查 `13:50–14:10` 窗口，真实分布是 **55.0 × 64 条 + 20.0 × 4 条**。
那 4 个 20 分低谷就是折线里的下沉点。

#### 几何反解证明渲染无偏差

先定位绘图区：网格线在 y=77/209/341/473/604（间距 132，5 条线），
即 `plot.top≈77.5`、`plot.bottom≈604.5`、`plot.height≈527`。

`LineChartWidget::paint()` 的 `auto_scale` 逻辑（`line_chart_widget.cpp:108-124`）
对 min=20 / max=55 会算出 span=35、pad=3.5 → lo=16.5、hi=58.5。

| 数据点 | 计算 y_ratio | 计算 y | 实测 y |
|--------|-------------|--------|--------|
| 55.0（主体，最大值） | (55−16.5)/42 = 0.9167 | 604.5 − 0.9167×527 = **121.4** | **121** ✓ |
| 20.0（低谷，最小值） | (20−16.5)/42 = 0.0833 | 604.5 − 0.0833×527 = **560.6** | **561** ✓ |

两项都精确吻合。折线画的是序列的最大值和最小值——这正是 `auto_scale`
上下各留 10% 边距的定义，**不是 bug**。

#### 预测性验证：换一个数据窗口再截一张

查此刻最近 120 条，分布是 `55.0 × 120`（全等值）。按代码逻辑预测：
全等值时 `span < 1e-6` 走 ±5 兜底（lo=50, hi=60），55 分应落在
ratio=0.5，即 **y=341 的水平线**。

板端用 `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ./weaknet_dashboard --screenshot` 重截：

| 检查项 | 预测 | 实测 |
|--------|------|------|
| 绿色折线所在行 | y=341 | **y=341，673 px** ✓ |
| 图表中心「暂无历史数据」(#999999) | 0 px | **0 px**（严格匹配）✓ |

预测与实测一致，反证了折线渲染与解析链路正确。

#### 排查中差点踩的坑：像素检测的容差

第一次做「中心提示文字」检测时用了 ±30 容差匹配 `#999999`，结果报
「640 px → 有提示文字」，与视觉和逻辑都矛盾。原因是容差把折线的抗锯齿
过渡色 `#8EB690` / `#8AB28C` 也算进去了。改成**严格相等**后结果是 0 px。

**教训**：像素断言的容差必须小于相邻语义色之间的距离，否则会把

共用一个 QLabel 会让后到者覆盖先到者的内容，因此底栏按来源拆分控件：

### ④ 顺带修掉的四个真 bug（不在首次审计的 5 项内）

**bug 1：初始化失败会永久卡死取数线程。**

`weaknet_init()` 在 `client/client.cpp:1348` 的实现是：

```cpp
if (g_client) return g_client->isConnected();
```

而 `connected_` 只在 `initConnection()` 里赋值一次。连接失败后 `g_client`
仍留在全局，于是后续每次 `weaknet_init()` 都走「已初始化」分支、
**永远返回 false**——板端开机早期 D-Bus 尚未就绪时，看板再也连不上，
而原 `DataFetchThread::run()` 在 init 失败时直接 `return`，线程直接退出。

修法两层：

- `DataSource::init()` 失败路径调用 `weaknet_cleanup()` 把全局客户端置空
  （副作用是 `Logger::shutdown()`，下次 init 再 `InitGoogleLogging()`——
  已实测 glog 的 Init/Shutdown 反复循环 3 轮安全）；
- `DataFetchThread::run()` 改为按 2s 退避重试，睡眠切成 100ms 片以响应
  `quit_requested_`；首次失败时发 `fetchFailed` + `refreshFinished`
  （后者是必需的，主线程靠它清 `refresh_in_flight_`，否则手动刷新按钮永久失效）。

**bug 2：状态栏「就绪」会吃掉失败提示。**

原 `onRefreshFinished` 靠检查状态栏文字是否以「失败」开头来决定是否复位。
但那是**跨轮持久状态**：第一轮失败、第二轮成功时，第二轮会被误判成仍失败，
永远停在错误文案。改成每轮独立的 `round_had_failure_` 标志，
`onFetchFailed` 置位、`onRefreshFinished` 读取并清零。

**bug 3：`DiagnosisSnapshot::primary_issue` 是孤儿字段。**

`dashboard_data.cpp:160` 解析了，`apply_diagnosis()` 里从未读过
（`:450`/`:452` 那两处 `snap.primary_issue` 属于 `apply_experience` 的
`ExperienceSnapshot`，不是同一个字段）。按「B 类：给已解析字段接入真实消费者」

232	| 2 | `state_color(snap.overall_state)`：`std::string` → `QString` 隐式转换不存在 | 编译失败 |
233	| 3 | 同上，另一处 `state_color(item.state)` | 编译失败 |
234	
235	这证明「未编译验证」不是形式主义——**代码确实有错**。
236	
237	### 另一个重要发现：枚举值猜错了
238	
239	`server/include/assurance/health_state.hpp:15-23` 的真实取值是：
240	
241	```cpp
242	enum class HealthState { GOOD, DEGRADED, BAD, UNKNOWN };
243	```
244	
245	我之前写的是 `HEALTHY` / `FAILED`，**全错**。coverage 同理：
246	是 `FULL_FOR_PROFILE` 而不是 `FULL`。已全部修正，测试也同步更新。
247	
248	## 构建
249	
250	### 只构建数据层（无需 Qt，无需 libweaknet）
251	
252	```bash
253	cmake -S qt_dashboard -B build-qt-dashboard -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
254	cmake --build build-qt-dashboard -j$(nproc)
255	ctest --test-dir build-qt-dashboard --output-on-failure
256	```
257	
258	### 构建完整看板（需要 Qt 开发包）
259	
260	```bash
261	cmake -S qt_dashboard -B build-qt-dashboard \
262	  -DWEAKN_DASHBOARD_WITH_UI=ON \
263	  -DWEAKNET_CLIENT_LIB=/path/to/libweaknet.so
264	cmake --build build-qt-dashboard -j$(nproc)
265	```
266	
267	`WEAKNET_CLIENT_LIB` 不硬编码路径，因为板端可能直接链接已安装的库。
268	
269	### 交叉编译到 ARM64（宿主机直出，不用 Docker/QEMU）
270	
271	```bash
272	./qt_dashboard/tools/build-arm64.sh
273	```
274	
275	关键技巧：**moc 用宿主机 x86 的，编译器用 arm64 的**。moc 是构建期工具，
276	产物只是展开 `Q_OBJECT` 宏的普通 C++ 源码，**与目标架构无关**。
277	
278	前置条件（脚本启动时会一次性检查并说明缺什么）：
279	
280	1. sysroot 里有 arm64 Qt5 开发文件 → `./qt_dashboard/tools/fetch-qt-arm64-sysroot.sh`
281	2. 宿主机有 x86 moc → `sudo apt install qtbase5-dev-tools`（零卸载）
282	3. 已构建 arm64 `libweaknet.so` → `cmake -B build-arm64-native ...`
283	
284	产物：`build-qt-arm64/weaknet_dashboard`（约 399 KB，glibc 需求仅 2.17）。
285	
286	## 上板运行还缺什么
287	
288	**只剩 HDMI 物理链路。** 交叉编译、板端启动、真实取数、离屏渲染、
289	VNC 图形栈、15 分钟长稳都已实测通过。
290	
291	接上 HDMI 显示器后，用 `eglfs` 直接跑（需要 `/dev/dri` 权限）：
292	
293	```bash
294	ssh board 'sudo QT_QPA_PLATFORM=eglfs /tmp/weaknet_dashboard'
295	```
296	
297	### VNC 能验证什么、不能验证什么
298	
299	已用 `libqvnc.so` 验证图形栈（光栅化、事件分发、GUI 循环）与渲染正确性。
300	但以下只在物理链路暴露，**必须实机**：
301	
302	- HDMI 时序 / EDID 协商 / 分辨率与刷新率
303	- 热插拔（插入、拔出、切换）
304	- 显存带宽与 eglfs 直出路径
305	- 板端 `/dev/dri` 权限与 KMS 驱动行为
306	
307	### 已排除的路径（留作记录，避免重复试）
308	
309	板端 `apt install qtbase5-dev` 会级联移除 200+ KDE 包，不可用：
310	
311	```text
312	$ ssh board 'apt-get -s install qtbase5-dev > /tmp/qt-dryrun.txt'
313	$ grep -c '^Remv' /tmp/qt-dryrun.txt   →  1
314	$ grep -c '^Inst' /tmp/qt-dryrun.txt   →  23
315	```
316	
317	`Remv` 行只有 1 条容易误读成「只删一个」，但方括号里是**全部级联受害者**
318	（`plasma-workspace`、`kwin-x11`、`sddm` 等 200+）。且 `apt-cache search`
319	确认**不存在 gles 变体的 dev 包**，无绕开方案。
320	
321	因此 ARM64 走「x86 moc + arm64 编译器 + sysroot 里的 Qt 头/库」这条路，
322	完全不动板端包管理器。
323	
324	## 与现有代码的边界
325	
326	- 不修改 `client/` 下任何现有文件
327	- 不修改根 `CMakeLists.txt`
328	- 不修改 `scripts/`
329	- 不新增 D-Bus 方法（全部使用现有只读方法）
330	
331	## 下一步
332	
333	> **2026-11-06 首次审计**列出 5 项：代码层面已无孤儿接口，每个 `QLabel` 都有唯一写者，
334	> 每个 `JsonReader` / `DataSource` 公开方法都有真实调用者。**但「代码写完」不等于「可交付」**。
335	>
336	> **2026-11-06 五续**：首次审计的第 2（声明与实现不符）、4（UI 测试为零）、
337	> 5（eglfs 默认值）项已完成，明细见文末「本轮修复记录」。
338	> 剩余 **2 项**：HDMI 实机验收、`auto_scale` 产品决策。
339	
340	### 1. HDMI 实机验收（唯一功能性阻塞项，仍待完成）
341	
342	接显示器后走 `-platform eglfs` 实机验证。VNC 只能证明图形栈、光栅化与事件循环
343	是通的，**不能**替代 HDMI 时序、EDID 协商、分辨率切换与热插拔。
344	
345	### 2. `auto_scale` 纵轴策略未决（仍待完成，需产品决策）
346	
347	当前会把小波动放大到撑满全高（实测 20↔55 的 4 个低谷即撑满 121..561），
348	诊断场景下可能让「轻微波动」看起来像「剧烈抖动」。是否改固定 0–100、
349	或提供两种模式切换，**需要产品决策而非技术决策**，待实机看过效果再定。
350	
351	### 其他（非阻塞）
352	
353	- 视需要补充维度详情、告警高亮等交互
354	- 15 分钟长稳不等于周级；断网重连、服务重启等异常路径未覆盖
355	- `MainWindow` 的接线与 `DataFetchThread` 的并发仍无自动化回归
356	  （`LineChartWidget` 已补 8 条像素测试，但窗口层只靠板端截图人眼对账）
357	- **初始化失败后的「自动重连成功」未经实测**。已验证的是「持续失败时线程不退出、
358	  按 2s 重试」，**没有**验证「环境恢复后自己连上」——那需要中途修复 D-Bus 环境，
359	  x86 上无法构造。该路径目前只有代码推理支撑（`weaknet_cleanup()` 置空全局客户端
360	  → 下次 `weaknet_init()` 走完整重建），不能宣称已恢复
361	
362	是否升格为正式 OpenSpec change：**待 HDMI 实机验证后再评估**。
363	当前代码仍是探索性质，未接入根构建、未修改任何既有文件。
364	
365	## 本轮修复记录（2026-11-06 五续）
366	
367	上一轮审计列出 5 项，本轮清掉 3 项，全部有可复算证据。
368	
369	### ① `line_chart_widget.hpp` 声明与实现不符 → 补 8 条像素测试
370	
371	`paint(QPainter*, QRect)` 之所以与 `paintEvent()` 分离、之所以不读
372	`this->width()`，**唯一动机就是可被像素测试**。本轮补上那个消费者：
373	`tests/test_line_chart_widget.cpp`（8 个用例，341 行）。
374	
375	覆盖：空序列不画线、非空序列画线、**legacy 在中间断开连线**（带同进程对照组）、
376	legacy 点仍留灰色标记、单点不除零、全等值不贴边、换数据后 `legacy_` 与
377	`scores_` 保持等长、退化矩形安全返回。
378	
379	判据刻意排除坐标轴文字行列（上一轮抗锯齿边缘 `0x88` 混白落到 `0x9E` 导致假失败），
380	并用**变异验证**证明断言可失败：把 `if (legacy_.at(i))` 改成 `if (false)` 后
381	3 条用例立即失败，改回后 `git diff` 为空。
382	
383	### ② UI 层自动化测试为零 → 数据层同时补到 39 条
384	
385	新增 3 条数据层用例（`PrimaryIssueSurvivesWithoutSummaryTemplate` 等），
386	数据层从 36 条升到 **39 条**。配合上面的 8 条像素测试，
387	`ctest` 现在覆盖 JSON 解析 + 图表绘制两层，仅剩窗口接线无自动化。
388	
389	### ③ `main.cpp` 的 eglfs 默认值与实现不一致 → 补 `apply_default_platform()`
390	
391	头注释写「默认走 `eglfs`」但代码没设置任何默认值。现在由
392	`apply_default_platform()` 落实，优先级为：
393	环境变量已设 → 不动；显式 `-platform` → Qt 自行覆盖；`--screenshot` → `offscreen`；
394	其余 → `eglfs`。
395	
396	三场景实测（x86 无 DRM）：
397	- 不设环境变量、不带 `--screenshot` → 报 `Could not initialize egl display`（eglfs 生效）
398	- `--screenshot` 且不设环境变量 → 成功保存 1024×700 PNG（自动切 offscreen）
399	- 已设 `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen` → 正常运行（不被覆盖）
400	
401	注：`--screenshot` 必须抢在 `QApplication` 构造前判断，所以手工扫 `argv`，
402	不能用 `QCommandLineParser`（构造时平台插件已定）。
403	
404	### ④ 顺带修掉的四个真问题（不在首次审计的 5 项内）
405	
406	**初始化失败会永久卡死取数线程。** `weaknet_init()` 在 `client.cpp:1348` 的实现是
407	`g_client` 非空时直接 `return g_client->isConnected()`，而 `connected_` 只在
408	`initConnection()` 里赋值一次。连接失败后全局客户端仍留着，于是后续每次
409	`weaknet_init()` 都走「已初始化」分支、永远返回 `false` —— 板端开机早期
410	D-Bus 未就绪时，看板就再也连不上了。修法：`DataSource::init()` 失败路径调用
411	`weaknet_cleanup()` 把全局客户端置空（副作用是 `Logger::shutdown()`，
412	已实测 glog Init/Shutdown 反复循环安全），`DataFetchThread::run()` 改为按
413	2s 退避重试并切片睡眠以响应 `quit_requested_`。
414	
415	**状态栏「就绪」会吃掉失败提示。** 原来 `onRefreshFinished` 靠检查状态栏文字
416	是否以「失败」开头来决定是否复位，但那是跨轮持久状态：第一轮失败、第二轮成功时
417	第二轮会被误判成仍失败。改成每轮独立的 `round_had_failure_` 标志。
418	
419	**`DiagnosisSnapshot::primary_issue` 是孤儿字段。** 解析了从未读过。
420	按「给已解析字段接入真实消费者」处理：`summary_template` 为空时用它兜底显示
421	「首要问题 xxx」，两者都空则隐藏。补了 3 条用例覆盖（含空串不等于缺失）。
422	
423	**标题与实际查询不符。** `-i` 不传时标题停在 `build_ui()` 的
424	「历史趋势（分数）」，但实际查的是全部网卡，且 `history_limit_` 也停在类默认值。
425	现在 `main.cpp` **无条件**调用 `setInterface()`（不传则传空串），
426	`build_ui()` 不再写标题，`setInterface()` 成为唯一标题写者。
427	帮助文案也从「默认自动检测」改成「不传则查询全部网卡」——「自动检测」在代码里不存在。

# Qt 本地看板（实验性）

> **状态**：完整调用链已打通，**已实际编译 + 链接 + 运行验证**
> **创建日期**：2026-11-05
> **依据**：根目录 `内核模块技术栈引入讨论.md` 方向一（路径 A1）

## 这是什么

设备接 HDMI 显示器时，在开发板本地打开一个 Qt 看板，查看 WeakNet 的实时诊断情况。

## 架构

```
main.cpp                    QApplication + 命令行
  └── MainWindow            顶栏 / 维度列表 / 趋势图 / 诊断栏
        ├── DataFetchThread  QThread，后台取数（禁止在 UI 线程调 D-Bus）
        │     └── DataSource 唯一直接调用 libweaknet 的地方
        │           └── weaknet_get_*()   ← client/weaknet_client.h
        ├── LineChartWidget  QPainter 自绘折线图
        └── parse_xxx()      JSON → POD（纯函数，可单测）
```

## 关键设计决定

### 数据层：复用现有 C API，不重写 D-Bus

`client/weaknet_client.h` 已经提供完整封装（29 KB，50+ 函数），统一签名：

```c
bool weaknet_get_xxx(char* buffer, size_t buffer_size,
                     char* error_buffer, size_t error_size);
```

返回 JSON 字符串。看板直接链接 `libweaknet.so`，**服务端零改动**。

### 为什么必须有后台线程

`weaknet_get_*` 内部是 D-Bus 同步调用（`dbus_connection_send_with_reply_and_block`）。
服务端忙或连不上时单次调用可能阻塞数秒。放在 UI 线程 → 界面冻结。
`DataFetchThread` 把它们全部挪到后台，通过信号把结果送回主线程。

### JSON：手写轻量解析，不引第三方库

项目全仓不使用 nlohmann/json，`server/src/net_info.cpp:15` 明确写了这一点。
采用「路径式查找」（`getString("overall.state")`）而非完整 DOM，
因为看板只读少数已知字段。

### 图表：QPainter 自绘，不用 Qt Charts

1. 板端**没有** `libqt5charts5`（实测）
2. `QChart` 在 Mesa 软件渲染下性能差
3. 自绘可以 `render()` 到 `QImage` 做像素级断言

### 缓冲区自动扩容

C API 不报告截断。取数层先给 8 KB，用 `JsonReader::valid()` 判断完整性，
不合法就翻倍重试，上限 4 MB。**绝不把截断的 JSON 当成功**。

## 目录结构

```
qt_dashboard/
├── README.md
├── CMakeLists.txt             独立 project
├── main.cpp                   入口
├── data/                      ← 不依赖 Qt
│   ├── json_reader.{hpp,cpp}      轻量 JSON 读取
│   ├── dashboard_data.{hpp,cpp}   POD + 解析
│   └── data_source.{hpp,cpp}      调 libweaknet
├── ui/                        ← 依赖 Qt
│   ├── line_chart_widget.{hpp,cpp}  QPainter 折线图
│   ├── data_fetch_thread.{hpp,cpp}  后台取数
│   └── main_window.{hpp,cpp}        主窗口
└── tests/
    ├── test_json_reader.cpp        39 个用例（数据层）
    └── test_line_chart_widget.cpp   8 个用例（UI 像素级）
```

## 验证状态（2026-11-05 实测，2026-11-06 续验）

| 项 | 状态 | 证据 |
|------|------|------|
| 数据层单测 | ✅ **39/39 通过** | `ctest` 0.02s，含 6 个真机样本用例 |
| UI 像素级测试 | ✅ **8/8 通过** | `QImage` 渲染断言，含对照组与变异验证 |
| 取数层编译 | ✅ 通过 | 链接真实 `weaknet_client.h`，签名全对 |
| UI 层 **moc** | ✅ **3/3 生成成功** | `Q_OBJECT`/信号槽声明语法正确 |
| UI 层编译 | ✅ **零警告** | `-Wall -Wextra` 全部通过（12/12 编译单元） |
| **完整链接** | ✅ **成功** | 378 KB（386856 B）可执行文件，无 undefined reference |
| **x86 实际运行** | ✅ **启动正常** | `--help` 正确输出；`offscreen` 下持续运行不崩溃 |
| **ARM64 交叉编译** | ✅ **成功** | `tools/build-arm64.sh`，最高 glibc 需求 `2.17`（板端 `2.31`） |
| **初始失败不卡死线程** | ✅ **实测重试循环** | 指向不存在的 D-Bus socket → 每 2s 重试一次并 `weaknet_cleanup()`，线程不退出、界面仍可截图 |
| **默认平台插件** | ✅ **三场景实测** | 无变量→eglfs；`--screenshot`→offscreen；已设变量不覆盖 |
| **板端真实运行** | ✅ **成功** | arm64 二进制在 `radxa-cubie-a7a` 上启动，D-Bus 连接建立 |
| **真实取数** | ✅ **3/3 成功** | experience 4129B / diagnosis 285B / history 50KB（interfaces/health 已随孤儿清理删除） |
| **真实渲染** | ✅ **像素级验证** | offscreen 截图 1024x742，折线横跨绘图区，状态色齐全 |
| **新控件真渲染到屏** | ✅ **逐项对账** | 顶栏色块 `绿●8 琥珀●1 红●0 灰●4` 与 `busctl GetNetworkExperience` 的 13 维度状态完全一致 |
| **legacy 断开连线** | ✅ **自动化测试 + 变异验证** | 8 条像素测试，破坏 legacy 逻辑后 3 条立即可靠失败 |
| **VNC 图形栈** | ✅ **外部取帧验证** | `libqvnc.so` 跑通，RFB 客户端读到真实帧缓冲 1024x700/32bpp |
| **15 分钟长稳** | ✅ **零泄漏零错误** | RSS 稳定 60300 kB 不变，fd/线程恒定，日志 0 错 |
| HDMI 实机显示 | ⏳ 待做 | 显示器未在位（`HDMI disconnected`） |

### 2026-11-06 续：孤儿清理与真实消费者

上一轮遗留两类问题，已按 CLAUDE.md 的 orphan 铁律处理完毕：

**A 类 —— 删除无消费者的接口**

`LineChartWidget::clear/pointCount/setLineColor/setAutoScale`、`JsonReader::rootIsArray/rootArraySize/raw`、
`EvidenceItem` 结构体、`FetchResult::buffer_used`、`DataSource::initialized()`、
`DiagnosisSnapshot::raw_json`、`HistoryPoint::overall_quality/iface`、
`HistorySeries::interface_name/empty()`。全部零调用，保留即为孤儿。

**B 类 —— 给已解析字段接入真实消费者**

| 字段 | 去向 |
|------|------|
| `count_by_state` | 顶栏彩色 ● 汇总「绿 8 / 黄 1 / 红 0 / 灰 4」 |
| `assessment_profile` + `overall_coverage` | 顶栏「档位 INTERNET_ACCESS / 覆盖 PARTIAL」 |
| `warnings` | 底栏红色警告行（无警告时隐藏、不占版面） |
| `primary_issue` | `summary_template` 为空时兜底成「首要问题 xxx」；两者都空则隐藏 |
| `summary_template` | 底栏独立人读摘要行 |
| `secondary_issues` / `excluded_causes` / `evidence_refs` | 计数上屏 + 明细进 tooltip |
| `actions[].priority` | 诊断行显示「建议动作 N 项（最高优先级 P）」 |
| `SleItem::reason` | 每个维度状态标签的 tooltip |
| `HistoryPoint::legacy` | 折线图断开连线 + 灰色空心点（v1/v2 不同量纲） |
| `schema_version` | 解析守卫：非 0/2 直接标成不可用，避免按 v2 路径静默取空 |

底栏按数据源拆分成 5 个独立 QLabel（experience 2 个、diagnosis 3 个），

1	# Change workflow
2	
3	<!-- autoai:workflow-binding:v1
4	{"role":"workflow-documentation","facts":["schema-upgrade-v2-explicit","schema-upgrade-v3-explicit","project-profile-command-ids","single-evaluator-verdict"]}

6	
7	quick_brief: Plan every product surface and real consumer in OpenSpec, bind Generator and Evaluator commands to it, reject unmatched candidates, and archive only a fresh unified Pass.
8	
9	```mermaid
10	flowchart LR
11	  U[User document or request] --> P[Planner investigates callers and entrypoints]
12	  P --> O[Proposal + specs + design + tasks + surface inventory]
13	  O --> R{Human review}
14	  R -->|revise| P
15	  R -->|approved| G["Generator: one task"]
16	  G --> T["RED → GREEN → REFACTOR → REGRESSION"]
17	  T --> V["Surface-bound task evidence"]
18	  T -->|unexpected failure| D[Systematic RCA]
19	  D -->|direct fix| T
20	  D -->|three failed fixes or changed assumptions| P
21	  V --> C["all_done: footprint + surface candidate report"]
22	  C -->|unplanned surface or wrong plan| P
23	  C --> S["Evaluator stage 1: specification compliance"]
24	  S -->|implementation gap| G
25	  S -->|planning gap| P
26	  S --> Q["Evaluator stage 2: quality + candidate review"]
27	  Q -->|missing consumer or bad implementation| G
28	  Q -->|contract, scope or budget change| P
29	  Q --> E["Independent real-consumer commands + one verdict"]
30	  E -->|Fail| G
31	  E -->|Blocked| P
32	  E -->|fresh Pass| A[Archive wrapper]
33	  A --> M[Main specs + archived evidence]
34	```
35	
36	## Product-surface closure
37	
38	Every added, modified, deprecated or removed production surface must form this closed chain:
39	
40	```text
41	approved requirement -> task -> producer -> real consumer/entrypoint
42	                    -> Generator closing evidence -> independent Evaluator command
43	                    -> observable result
44	```
45	
46	The seven surface kinds and their minimum consumers are:
47	
48	| kind | required consumer | minimum proof |
49	|---|---|---|
50	| `internal_api` | `production_caller` | A production path invokes it through a real product entrypoint; a unit test calling it directly does not count. |
51	| `external_api` | `representative_external` | A representative downstream consumer uses installed/exported artifacts and compiles, links and, where applicable, runs. |
52	| `callback_or_plugin` | `registration_dispatch` | Both registration and an actual dispatch that reaches the implementation. |
53	| `cli` | `real_entrypoint` | The real executable, with observable arguments, output, exit code or state change. |
54	| `configuration` | `real_entrypoint` | A real process reads the value and changes observable behavior; parser-only tests are insufficient. |
55	| `protocol_or_persistence` | `producer_consumer_pair` | A real producer/consumer or compatibility path, not one-sided serialization alone. |
56	| `build_or_install` | `downstream_build` | A downstream configure/build/link and any necessary runtime check. |
57	
58	“Might be useful later” is not a consumer. Delete such an interface or return to Planner. File-local helpers remain implementation details, but every changed production path/candidate must still receive an Evaluator disposition.
59	
60	## Integration Completeness v1
61	
62	Planner puts exactly one closed block in `design.md`. `reviewed_inventory` is the portable default. Choose `clang_ast` only by explicit design decision, with a safe repository-relative `compile_commands_path`, complete translation-unit coverage and compatible Clang tools. AST only improves candidate discovery; it never proves a consumer or runtime behavior.
63	
64	````markdown
65	<!-- autoai:integration-completeness:v1 -->
66	```json
67	{
68	  "schema_version": 1,
69	  "discovery": {
70	    "mode": "reviewed_inventory",
71	    "compile_commands_path": null
72	  },
73	  "surfaces": [
74	    {
75	      "id": "surface-health-refresh",
76	      "kind": "internal_api",
77	      "name": "health::Service::refresh()",
78	      "change_kind": "added",
79	      "contract_impact": "compatible",
80	      "compatibility": null,
81	      "producer_paths": ["include/health/service.hpp", "src/health/service.cpp"],
82	      "consumer_kind": "production_caller",
83	      "consumer_paths": ["src/health/daemon.cpp"],
84	      "entrypoint": "health daemon refresh cycle",
85	      "evidence_contracts": [
86	        {
87	          "probe_id": "probe-health-refresh-test-current",
88	          "kind": "test",
89	          "role": "current",
90	          "argv": ["ctest", "--test-dir", "build", "-R", "health_refresh", "--output-on-failure"],
91	          "expected_exit_codes": [0],
92	          "output_contains": "100% tests passed"
93	        },
94	        {
95	          "probe_id": "probe-health-refresh-behavior-current",
96	          "kind": "behavior",
97	          "role": "current",
98	          "argv": ["build/bin/health-daemon", "--refresh-once"],
99	          "expected_exit_codes": [0],
100	          "output_contains": "health-refresh-ok"
101	        }
102	      ],
103	      "requirement_refs": [
104	        {
105	          "spec_path": "specs/health/spec.md",
106	          "operation": "ADDED",
107	          "requirement": "Refresh running health state",
108	          "scenarios": ["Daemon triggers refresh"]
109	        }
110	      ],
111	      "task_ids": ["1.2"],
112	      "verify_kinds": ["test", "behavior"],
113	      "task_obligations": [
114	        {
115	          "task_id": "1.2",
116	          "verify_kinds": ["test", "behavior"],
117	          "evidence_roles": ["current"]
118	        }
119	      ],
120	      "expected_observation": "The running daemon invokes refresh and publishes the new state.",
121	      "symbol_identities": null
122	    }
123	  ]
124	}
125	```
126	<!-- /autoai:integration-completeness:v1 -->
127	````
128	
129	`id` starts with `surface-`. Requirement references must exactly match a delta requirement/scenario; task IDs must exactly match leaf tasks and their `Covers` edges. Each task obligation uses only Verify kinds declared by that task. Across a surface, obligations must exactly cover the Cartesian product of top-level Verify kinds and required roles. 141

145	```
146	说明：创建变更目录 `openspec/changes/http-request-latency-monitor/`，包含 `design.md` 和 `harness/` 子目录。`--switch` 表示将其设为当前活动 change。

154	**Step 3: 校验并冻结规划**

167	# 现在才能改代码！改完后提交

171	**Step 5: 记录 evidence 并完成任务**

174	bash scripts/change_footprint.sh http-request-latency-monitor --json
175	
176	# 记录 build 证据（由于 eBPF 运行时需 ARM64 真机，用 unavailable_hardware 例外走 ALTERNATIVE）
177	bash scripts/task_verify.sh 1 --phase alternative --kind build \
178	  --exception-id exc-no-target-hardware --path server/src/http_latency.bpf.c \
179	  --project-command build-server
180	
181	# 完成任务
182	bash scripts/task_verify.sh --complete 1
183	
184	# 对 task 2 和 task 3 重复相同操作
185	bash scripts/task_verify.sh 2 --phase alternative --kind build ...
186	bash scripts/task_verify.sh --complete 2
187	bash scripts/task_verify.sh 3 --phase alternative --kind build ...
188	bash scripts/task_verify.sh --complete 3
189	```
190	说明：`--project-command build-server` 会执行 `scripts/project_command.sh build-server --change http-request-latency-monitor --json`（包装器形式），evidence 记录的是这个包装器 argv。task 的 `--path` 必须在 exception 允许的路径范围内。

192	**Step 6: 刷新集成报告**

195	```

199	
200	**Step 7: 生成 evaluation 并完成评估**

203	bash scripts/evaluator_check.sh --begin
204	
205	# 运行独立验证命令（用 --project-command，与 Generator 证据独立）
206	bash scripts/evaluator_check.sh --run --kind build --project-command build-server
207

209	bash scripts/evaluation_template.sh http-request-latency-monitor
210	# 手工或 evaluation_fix.sh 填充 TODO 字段
211	
212	# 预检 + 完成
213	bash scripts/pre_finish.sh http-request-latency-monitor
214	bash scripts/evaluator_check.sh --finish
215	```
216	说明：Evaluator 是独立于 Generator 的验证，不能复用 Generator 的命令输出。`--finish` 会校验所有 fingerprints、evidence 完整性、integration completeness。最终 verdict 为 Pass 后才能归档。
217	
218	### 归档阶段
219	
220	**Step 8: 归档**
221	```bash
222	bash scripts/change_archive.sh http-request-latency-monitor
223	```
224	说明：归档将 change 目录移到 `openspec/changes/archive/`，主 spec 更新，active selector 清空。**归档后必须全量提交**，确保工作区干净。
225	
226	### 关键注意事项
227	
228	- **surface 设计**：纯编译期变更的 surface（如新增 eBPF 探针，运行时需 ARM64 真机）应使用 `"kind":"build_or_install"` + `"runnable_artifact":false`，避免 `--plan-check` 报 `surface needs test or behavior evidence`。
229	- **probe argv 格式**：使用 `--project-command` 时，`evidence_contracts` 的 `argv` 必须写包装器形式 `["scripts/project_command.sh","<command-id>","--change","<change>","--json"]`，不能写裸命令如 `["make","-C","server"]`。
230	- **eBPF 编译**：必须通过 ARM64 Docker 容器 `weaknet-arm64-dev` 编译，禁止在 x86 开发机上直接 `make`。
231	- **design.md 不可修改**：记录 evidence 后不能再改 design.md 的任何字段（含 exception task_ids、classification 路径、thresholds），否则指纹变化会导致所有 evidence 作废。
232	- **代码先存在时不追认**：若功能代码已写好并提交，不要创建 change 试图"追认"它。要么直接提交为普通 commit，要么 `git revert` 后走完整流程。
233	
234	`change_kind` is `added`, `modified`, `deprecated` or `removed`. `contract_impact` is `compatible`, `breaking`, `deprecation` or `removal`; the last two pair only with deprecated/removed. Non-compatible surfaces carry the closed compatibility fields `old_consumer_paths`, `replacement_consumer_paths`, `replacement_policy`, `expected_old_result`, `migration_path` and `exit_condition`. Set `replacement_policy` to `required` whenever a replacement path exists. Only a removal whose referenced requirements are all `REMOVED` may use `requirement_approved_none`, and then the replacement path array must be empty. Evidence roles are `current`, `old_consumer`, `replacement_consumer` and `absence_probe`: compatible needs current; breaking/deprecation need old and replacement; removal needs old and absence, plus replacement when planned.
235	
236	Run `scripts/integration_surface_check.sh <change> --plan-check --json` before human approval and planning freeze. A valid plan is intent, not proof that paths are implemented.
237	
238	## Generator closure
239	
240	Generator handles one verifiable task at a time. Before coding, compare the requested change with the frozen surface inventory. If implementation needs a new interface, entrypoint, consumer, dependency, target, compatibility behavior or evidence obligation, stop and return to Planner; do not add it first and document it later.
241	
242	A behavior task records RED as `ExpectedFailure`, implements the smallest GREEN against the same immutable focused test, then records declared REGRESSION evidence. Closing commands for an integrated task use repeatable bindings:
243	
244	```text
245	scripts/task_verify.sh <task-id> --phase regression --cycle <id> --kind <kind> \
246	  --surface <surface-id> \
247	  --surface-role <surface-id>=old_consumer \
248	  ... --project-command <command-id>
249	```
250	
251	Use `--project-command <command-id>` for a reviewed Project Profile operation, or `-- <argv...>` for an approved durable repository driver that is not a Profile command; the two forms are mutually exclusive. The command-ID form is recorded and matched as the normalized argv `scripts/project_command.sh <command-id> --change <active-change> --json`, so the Integration probe must declare that exact wrapper argv. Generator must not run `project_command.sh` first and then submit a second command to the evidence wrapper.
252	
253	`--surface` means role `current`. Bind only obligations assigned to this task and command kind. A surface-bound REGRESSION, or an approved non-environment ALTERNATIVE that closes an obligation, must match the planned probe's argv and expected exit codes byte-for-byte and its captured output must contain the planned marker; the ledger records the derived `surface_probe_bindings`. Hardware/external-service provisional ALTERNATIVE records the assigned surface roles and blocking exception but no fake closing probe. RED/GREEN, grep, static inspection, compile-only checks, self-reported success, or an unrelated successful command cannot close a consumer obligation. `scripts/task_verify.sh --complete <task-id>` is the only task-checkbox transition and rechecks current planning, source, TDD and surface evidence.
254	
255	Before adding a test or consumer fixture, decide whether it has durable regression/compatibility value. Durable assets remain in the project and count in the footprint. One-off experiments use the managed workspace and are cleaned after every command; `--complete`, final report refresh, Evaluation finish and archive all fail closed unless that workspace is empty.
256	
257	After every task is complete, run `scripts/integration_surface_check.sh <change> --refresh --json`. It derives `harness/integration-surface-report.json` from the frozen plan, implementation-base diff, footprint and optional AST discovery. It does not edit OpenSpec. A later `--check` must match exact current bytes; stale evidence is never silently refreshed by Evaluation or archive.
258	
259	## Independent review and verdict
260	
261	Evaluator is a separate attempt. Before `--begin`, read the actual committed, staged, unstaged, untracked and dirty-gitlink state plus `integration-surface-report.json`. Review every path/structural/AST candidate, including candidates not mapped to a planned surface. Independently execute real-consumer commands with the same `--surface` or `--surface-role` syntax on `evaluator_check.sh --run`.
262	
263	Evaluator must reject an accidental one-off probe in the Git review input and any closing command that depends on a temporary path scheduled for deletion. Independent one-off probes run through a fresh managed workspace. Archived evidence keeps exact argv, exit code, output digest/summary and assessment, not temporary source or binaries.
264	
265	Every candidate gets exactly one disposition and every planned surface gets exactly one assessment. A missing real consumer, unrelated evidence or missing evidence role is `Fail` and returns to Generator. An unplanned candidate or wrong requirement/task/classification/scope is `Blocked` and returns to Planner. An unavailable required environment is `Blocked`; it cannot be downgraded to residual risk. `Fail` has priority over `Blocked`, and the unified Evaluation remains the only verdict.
266	
267	When planning changes after implementation starts, affected tasks remain unchecked. Planner revises artifacts, runs strict validation and `--plan-check`, obtains renewed human approval, then uses `snapshot_update.sh --refresh-planning-baseline`. This never advances the frozen implementation base. An old v1/v2 evidence family is not implicitly upgraded; only an eligible evidence-empty change may use `task_verify.sh --upgrade-v3 <change>`.
268	
269	Fresh context is optional for high-risk tasks and independent review. Generate it with `change_status.sh --agent-context investigator|reviewer` or `--agent-context generator --task <id>`. The same worktree always has one writer; parallel agents may only perform read-only investigation or review. The optional linked-worktree pilot is explicitly leased through `harness_lock.sh isolation-*`; it never creates, commits, merges, pushes, stashes, resets, prunes or deletes Git state. Worktree creation and Git integration/cleanup remain user-owned.
270	
271	## Project capability control and derived navigation
272	
273	`.ai-harness/project-profile.json` is the reviewed description of modules, adapters, path roles, build targets/graph/distribution surfaces, stable command IDs and optional `capability_status` declarations. It is not a specification or state store. A command-backed capability is available by declaration and then subject to runtime checks; a commandless capability may be `unavailable`, `not-applicable` or `needs-approval`, while omission is reported as `absent`. Run `scripts/harness_doctor.sh --json` for read-only control-plane, capability and active-evidence diagnostics. Execute a reviewed operation through the evidence wrapper's `--project-command` option; the wrapper invokes `scripts/project_command.sh` and retains the canonical environment envelope under the active change. Direct execution does not create task or Evaluation evidence.
274	
275	The following navigation and governance views are advisory or policy inputs, never a second source of truth:
276	
277	- `scripts/project_index.sh --refresh --json` builds a Profile/source/toolchain-contract-bound project index; `--check` rejects stale bytes.
278	- `scripts/context_slice.sh <change> --refresh --json` orders P0 through P3 reading candidates under an explicit heuristic token budget. It never limits Evaluator diff or untracked-file review.
279	- `scripts/campaign.sh <campaign> --status --json` validates a read-only cross-change DAG and may suggest `--next-ready`; it never creates or selects a change.
280	- `scripts/event_audit.sh <change> --refresh --json` rebuilds a hash-chained projection from retained evidence.
281	- `scripts/organization_policy.sh --check --json` validates optional local/CI/release execution restrictions; policy can deny a Profile command but cannot create one.
282	
283	Legacy evidence stays in its declared schema. An eligible evidence-empty change may explicitly run `scripts/task_verify.sh --upgrade-v2 <change>` and then `scripts/task_verify.sh --upgrade-v3 <change>`; normal reruns and `--force` never perform an implicit evidence migration.

```mermaid

  O --> R{Human review}
  R -->|revise| P
  R -->|approved| G["Generator: one task"]
  G --> T["RED → GREEN → REFACTOR → REGRESSION"]

## Product-surface closure

Every added, modified, deprecated or removed production surface must form this closed chain:

```text
approved requirement -> task -> producer -> real consumer/entrypoint
                    -> Generator closing evidence -> independent Evaluator command
                    -> observable result
```

The seven surface kinds and their minimum consumers are:

| kind | required consumer | minimum proof |
|---|---|---|
| `internal_api` | `production_caller` | A production path invokes it through a real product entrypoint; a unit test calling it directly does not count. |
| `external_api` | `representative_external` | A representative downstream consumer uses installed/exported artifacts and compiles, links and, where applicable, runs. |
| `callback_or_plugin` | `registration_dispatch` | Both registration and an actual dispatch that reaches the implementation. |
| `cli` | `real_entrypoint` | The real executable, with observable arguments, output, exit code or state change. |
| `configuration` | `real_entrypoint` | A real process reads the value and changes observable behavior; parser-only tests are insufficient. |
| `protocol_or_persistence` | `producer_consumer_pair` | A real producer/consumer or compatibility path, not one-sided serialization alone. |
| `build_or_install` | `downstream_build` | A downstream configure/build/link and any necessary runtime check. |

“Might be useful later” is not a consumer. Delete such an interface or return to Planner. File-local helpers remain implementation details, but every changed production path/candidate must still receive an Evaluator disposition.

# 现在才能改代码！改完后提交
```
说明：**必须先 freeze 再改代码**。如果反序（先改代码再 freeze），diff 为空、footprint 无变化、`--path` 引用会不匹配。

**Step 5: 记录 evidence 并完成任务**
```bash
# 查看 footprint 状态
bash scripts/change_footprint.sh http-request-latency-monitor --json

# 记录 build 证据（由于 eBPF 运行时需 ARM64 真机，用 unavailable_hardware 例外走 ALTERNATIVE）
bash scripts/task_verify.sh 1 --phase alternative --kind build \
  --exception-id exc-no-target-hardware --path server/src/http_latency.bpf.c \
  --project-command build-server

# 完成任务
bash scripts/task_verify.sh --complete 1

# 对 task 2 和 task 3 重复相同操作
bash scripts/task_verify.sh 2 --phase alternative --kind build ...
bash scripts/task_verify.sh --complete 2
bash scripts/task_verify.sh 3 --phase alternative --kind build ...
bash scripts/task_verify.sh --complete 3
```
说明：`--project-command build-server` 会执行 `scripts/project_command.sh build-server --change http-request-latency-monitor --json`（包装器形式），evidence 记录的是这个包装器 argv。task 的 `--path` 必须在 exception 允许的路径范围内。

**Step 6: 刷新集成报告**
```bash
bash scripts/integration_surface_check.sh http-request-latency-monitor --refresh --json
```
说明：`--refresh` 从冻结的 plan、implementation-base diff 和 footprint 推导出 `integration-surface-report.json`。

### 评估阶段（Evaluator 角色）

**Step 7: 生成 evaluation 并完成评估**
```bash
# 开始 evaluation
bash scripts/evaluator_check.sh --begin

# 运行独立验证命令（用 --project-command，与 Generator 证据独立）
bash scripts/evaluator_check.sh --run --kind build --project-command build-server

# 生成 evaluation.json 骨架并填充
bash scripts/evaluation_template.sh http-request-latency-monitor
# 手工或 evaluation_fix.sh 填充 TODO 字段

# 预检 + 完成
bash scripts/pre_finish.sh http-request-latency-monitor
bash scripts/evaluator_check.sh --finish
```
说明：Evaluator 是独立于 Generator 的验证，不能复用 Generator 的命令输出。`--finish` 会校验所有 fingerprints、evidence 完整性、integration completeness。最终 verdict 为 Pass 后才能归档。

### 归档阶段

**Step 8: 归档**
```bash
bash scripts/change_archive.sh http-request-latency-monitor
```
说明：归档将 change 目录移到 `openspec/changes/archive/`，主 spec 更新，active selector 清空。**归档后必须全量提交**，确保工作区干净。

### 关键注意事项

- **surface 设计**：纯编译期变更的 surface（如新增 eBPF 探针，运行时需 ARM64 真机）应使用 `"kind":"build_or_install"` + `"runnable_artifact":false`，避免 `--plan-check` 报 `surface needs test or behavior evidence`。
- **probe argv 格式**：使用 `--project-command` 时，`evidence_contracts` 的 `argv` 必须写包装器形式 `["scripts/project_command.sh","<command-id>","--change","<change>","--json"]`，不能写裸命令如 `["make","-C","server"]`。
- **eBPF 编译**：必须通过 ARM64 Docker 容器 `weaknet-arm64-dev` 编译，禁止在 x86 开发机上直接 `make`。
- **design.md 不可修改**：记录 evidence 后不能再改 design.md 的任何字段（含 exception task_ids、classification 路径、thresholds），否则指纹变化会导致所有 evidence 作废。
- **代码先存在时不追认**：若功能代码已写好并提交，不要创建 change 试图"追认"它。要么直接提交为普通 commit，要么 `git revert` 后走完整流程。

`change_kind` is `added`, `modified`, `deprecated` or `removed`. `contract_impact` is `compatible`, `breaking`, `deprecation` or `removal`; the last two pair only with deprecated/removed. Non-compatible surfaces carry the closed compatibility fields `old_consumer_paths`, `replacement_consumer_paths`, `replacement_policy`, `expected_old_result`, `migration_path` and `exit_condition`. Set `replacement_policy` to `required` whenever a replacement path exists. Only a removal whose referenced requirements are all `REMOVED` may use `requirement_approved_none`, and then the replacement path array must be empty. Evidence roles are `current`, `old_consumer`, `replacement_consumer` and `absence_probe`: compatible needs current; breaking/deprecation need old and replacement; removal needs old and absence, plus replacement when planned.

Run `scripts/integration_surface_check.sh <change> --plan-check --json` before human approval and planning freeze. A valid plan is intent, not proof that paths are implemented.

## Generator closure

Generator handles one verifiable task at a time. Before coding, compare the requested change with the frozen surface inventory. If implementation needs a new interface, entrypoint, consumer, dependency, target, compatibility behavior or evidence obligation, stop and return to Planner; do not add it first and document it later.

A behavior task records RED as `ExpectedFailure`, implements the smallest GREEN against the same immutable focused test, then records declared REGRESSION evidence. Closing commands for an integrated task use repeatable bindings:

```text
scripts/task_verify.sh <task-id> --phase regression --cycle <id> --kind <kind> \
  --surface <surface-id> \
  --surface-role <surface-id>=old_consumer \
  ... --project-command <command-id>
```

Use `--project-command <command-id>` for a reviewed Project Profile operation, or `-- <argv...>` for an approved durable repository driver that is not a Profile command; the two forms are mutually exclusive. The command-ID form is recorded and matched as the normalized argv `scripts/project_command.sh <command-id> --change <active-change> --json`, so the Integration probe must declare that exact wrapper argv. Generator must not run `project_command.sh` first and then submit a second command to the evidence wrapper.

`--surface` means role `current`. Bind only obligations assigned to this task and command kind. A surface-bound REGRESSION, or an approved non-environment ALTERNATIVE that closes an obligation, must match the planned probe's argv and expected exit codes byte-for-byte and its captured output must contain the planned marker; the ledger records the derived `surface_probe_bindings`. Hardware/external-service provisional ALTERNATIVE records the assigned surface roles and blocking exception but no fake closing probe. RED/GREEN, grep, static inspection, compile-only checks, self-reported success, or an unrelated successful command cannot close a consumer obligation. `scripts/task_verify.sh --complete <task-id>` is the only task-checkbox transition and rechecks current planning, source, TDD and surface evidence.

Before adding a test or consumer fixture, decide whether it has durable regression/compatibility value. Durable assets remain in the project and count in the footprint. One-off experiments use the managed workspace and are cleaned after every command; `--complete`, final report refresh, Evaluation finish and archive all fail closed unless that workspace is empty.

After every task is complete, run `scripts/integration_surface_check.sh <change> --refresh --json`. It derives `harness/integration-surface-report.json` from the frozen plan, implementation-base diff, footprint and optional AST discovery. It does not edit OpenSpec. A later `--check` must match exact current bytes; stale evidence is never silently refreshed by Evaluation or archive.

## Independent review and verdict

Evaluator is a separate attempt. Before `--begin`, read the actual committed, staged, unstaged, untracked and dirty-gitlink state plus `integration-surface-report.json`. Review every path/structural/AST candidate, including candidates not mapped to a planned surface. Independently execute real-consumer commands with the same `--surface` or `--surface-role` syntax on `evaluator_check.sh --run`.

Evaluator must reject an accidental one-off probe in the Git review input and any closing command that depends on a temporary path scheduled for deletion. Independent one-off probes run through a fresh managed workspace. Archived evidence keeps exact argv, exit code, output digest/summary and assessment, not temporary source or binaries.

Every candidate gets exactly one disposition and every planned surface gets exactly one assessment. A missing real consumer, unrelated evidence or missing evidence role is `Fail` and returns to Generator. An unplanned candidate or wrong requirement/task/classification/scope is `Blocked` and returns to Planner. An unavailable required environment is `Blocked`; it cannot be downgraded to residual risk. `Fail` has priority over `Blocked`, and the unified Evaluation remains the only verdict.

When planning changes after implementation starts, affected tasks remain unchecked. Planner revises artifacts, runs strict validation and `--plan-check`, obtains renewed human approval, then uses `snapshot_update.sh --refresh-planning-baseline`. This never advances the frozen implementation base. An old v1/v2 evidence family is not implicitly upgraded; only an eligible evidence-empty change may use `task_verify.sh --upgrade-v3 <change>`.

Fresh context is optional for high-risk tasks and independent review. Generate it with `change_status.sh --agent-context investigator|reviewer` or `--agent-context generator --task <id>`. The same worktree always has one writer; parallel agents may only perform read-only investigation or review. The optional linked-worktree pilot is explicitly leased through `harness_lock.sh isolation-*`; it never creates, commits, merges, pushes, stashes, resets, prunes or deletes Git state. Worktree creation and Git integration/cleanup remain user-owned.

## Project capability control and derived navigation

`.ai-harness/project-profile.json` is the reviewed description of modules, adapters, path roles, build targets/graph/distribution surfaces, stable command IDs and optional `capability_status` declarations. It is not a specification or state store. A command-backed capability is available by declaration and then subject to runtime checks; a commandless capability may be `unavailable`, `not-applicable` or `needs-approval`, while omission is reported as `absent`. Run `scripts/harness_doctor.sh --json` for read-only control-plane, capability and active-evidence diagnostics. Execute a reviewed operation through the evidence wrapper's `--project-command` option; the wrapper invokes `scripts/project_command.sh` and retains the canonical environment envelope under the active change. Direct execution does not create task or Evaluation evidence.

The following navigation and governance views are advisory or policy inputs, never a second source of truth:

- `scripts/project_index.sh --refresh --json` builds a Profile/source/toolchain-contract-bound project index; `--check` rejects stale bytes.
- `scripts/context_slice.sh <change> --refresh --json` orders P0 through P3 reading candidates under an explicit heuristic token budget. It never limits Evaluator diff or untracked-file review.
- `scripts/campaign.sh <campaign> --status --json` validates a read-only cross-change DAG and may suggest `--next-ready`; it never creates or selects a change.
- `scripts/event_audit.sh <change> --refresh --json` rebuilds a hash-chained projection from retained evidence.
- `scripts/organization_policy.sh --check --json` validates optional local/CI/release execution restrictions; policy can deny a Profile command but cannot create one.

Legacy evidence stays in its declared schema. An eligible evidence-empty change may explicitly run `scripts/task_verify.sh --upgrade-v2 <change>` and then `scripts/task_verify.sh --upgrade-v3 <change>`; normal reruns and `--force` never perform an implicit evidence migration.

3. REFACTOR: remove duplication or improve names only while the focused test remains green; do not expand behavior or introduce an unapproved abstraction.
4. REGRESSION: run the relevant wider build, tests and representative behavior selected by the task and design.

Planner must put exactly one closed TDD Policy block in `design.md`, including an empty `exceptions` array when every task uses normal TDD:

````markdown
<!-- autoai:tdd-policy:v1 -->
```json
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "default": "required",
  "exceptions": []
}
```
<!-- /autoai:tdd-policy:v1 -->
````

Each exception has exactly `id`, `category`, `task_ids`, `paths`, `reason`, `alternative_verify_kinds`, and `exit_condition`. Categories are `generated_output`, `documentation_only`, `configuration_only`, `disposable_prototype`, `unavailable_hardware`, or `unavailable_external_service`. Its alternative kinds must exactly equal each covered task's declared Verify kinds. Exceptions are frozen with the planning baseline; Generator cannot add or widen one.

Record normal behavior evidence with `task_verify.sh <task> --phase red|green|regression --cycle <id> ... {--project-command <command-id> | -- <argv>}`. Use the command-ID form for reviewed Project Profile operations and raw argv only for an approved durable repository driver; they are mutually exclusive. The wrapper records the command-ID form as `scripts/project_command.sh <command-id> --change <active-change> --json`. For a verification v3 task, bind closing consumer evidence with `--surface <id>` for role `current` or repeat `--surface-role <id>=current|old_consumer|replacement_consumer|absence_probe` exactly as assigned by its approved task obligation. RED additionally requires focused `--test-path`, nonzero `--expect-exit`, `--failure-class`, `--expected-failure`, `--match-output`, and `--observed`; it is stored only as `ExpectedFailure` or `InvalidRed`, never Pass. GREEN must reuse the same normalized argv and unchanged focused test after a real source change. REGRESSION must cover every declared Verify kind and surface role. Complete only through `task_verify.sh --complete <task>`.

A temporary program cannot be a `--test-path`, `--path`, producer/consumer path or direct argv dependency. If a repeatable command needs one, keep a durable driver in the project and invoke it through `scripts/verification_workspace.sh run <change> -- ...`; the driver recreates the program beneath `AUTOAI_VERIFY_TMPDIR` from an empty directory. Command completion, task completion, Evaluation finish and archive verify that no temporary program remains.

Managed evidence timestamps are logically monotonic and tolerate at most five minutes of host-clock rollback. Timestamps farther than five minutes in the future are rejected both when appending evidence and during task/Evaluation/archive rechecks; wall-clock timestamps do not replace command results, fingerprints or output digests.

An approved exception uses `--phase alternative --exception-id <id>` and every declared alternative kind. A disposable prototype can never complete a task. Unavailable hardware or external service remains `blocking_untested` during Evaluation even after alternative evidence. Do not weaken assertions, narrow inputs or replace behavior with mock-only checks to manufacture GREEN.

When user code already exists before a test, preserve it and establish a focused characterization or regression path with explicit review; do not delete the user's implementation merely to recreate textbook RED.
